note: ő U+0151 (o with double acute (Hungarian)) → ö — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
Ő U+0150 (O with double acute) → Ö — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
ű U+0171 (u with double acute (Hungarian)) → ü — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
Ű U+0170 (U with double acute) → Ü — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
ā U+0101 (a with macron) → ä — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
Ā U+0100 (A with macron) → Ä — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
ō U+014D (o with macron) → ö — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
Ō U+014C (O with macron) → Ö — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
ū U+016B (u with macron) → ü — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
Ū U+016A (U with macron) → Ü — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
β U+03B2 (Greek small beta) → ß — a look-alike codepoint from another alphabet, not a German letter
ı U+0131 (Turkish dotless i) → i — a paste artefact that renders as a bare i
İ U+0130 (I with dot above) → I — a paste artefact that renders as a bare i
NFD input (o + combining diaeresis) composes to ö before folding
a MISSING umlaut is a language error — and in German usually a DIFFERENT WORD (schon/schön)
the ue digraph is NOT folded: Steuer, Feuer and Museum spell it as two ordinary letters
ss is NOT folded to ß: Maße and Masse are different words, and Swiss German writes ss throughout
